subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streams treat timeoutSeconds as an idle/no-progress timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling streaming transports?
rationale: This is likely the right repair, but it changes the operational meaning of an existing provider timeout and the external PR has not yet shown the real affected setup succeeding.

options.title: Require proof, then accept idle-timeout parity
options.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama proof and merge if it confirms the OpenClaw chat or infer path completes with this timeout behavior.

options.title: Reject the timeout semantic change
options.body: Ask for a different fix if maintainers want timeoutSeconds to remain a total wall-clock cap for native Ollama streams.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept idle-timeout parity
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted remote or slow Ollama proof and merge if it confirms the OpenClaw chat or infer path completes with this timeout behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama stream history makes this the best available code-path owner for the native stream behavior choice.
